text_block_list.text:
Today is Valentine's Day.
While I was working in the trainer's office—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Happy Valentine's!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Today is the day we express our gratitude with sweets!
Naturally, I too have prepared some chocolate for the occasion!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"There, no need to be shy!
Grab it, open it, and eat it right away!"
Urged on by her, I opened the package to find several small pieces of chocolate inside.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What's the matter?
Aren't you going to eat?
To be honest, I was terrified to eat the food she gave me.
However—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And after I worked so hard to make it...
choice_data_list: (If I had truly put my heart into it...!)

text_block_list.text: Throwing caution to the wind, I tossed it into my mouth.

“—It melts smoothly in the mouth, with a gentle sweetness
that never feels cloying.”

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh, of course.
Did you really think I could fail at something as simple as cooking?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: More importantly—excuse me for a moment.
Saying so, Agnes Tachyon leaned in close. And then—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Sniff sniff...
*sniffle*...

I instinctively pull back as she sniffs my body.
Her expression is one of satisfaction.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah, looking good!
This is definitely a success!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, we got some great data!
Thank you, Guinea Pig-kun!
Without saying much, Agnes Tachyon simply left the Trainer's Room.
Afterward—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Huh? Does anyone else smell chocolate?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Is it because of Valentine's?
Even so, that's an intensely sweet smell...
It didn't take long to realize that my body odor had been turned into that of chocolate.

What spread through my mouth wasn't a sweet flavor—
but the taste of a pork bowl loaded with garlic.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"It's what they call allithiamine.
It works wonders for relieving fatigue."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: I combined ingredients packed with Vitamin B1 and allicin, compressed them, and that was the result.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I chose this out of consideration for your fatigue.
Chocolate can certainly help soothe the nerves,
but it also raises blood sugar levels, after all.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Above all, it's quite delicious, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, is that so? What a relief!
To tell the truth, I hadn't tasted it myself!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Let's see, I'll try one piece as wellâ

With that said, Agnes Tachyon tossed
a single piece of (pork bowl-flavored) chocolate into her mouth.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? What's this?
The gap between its looks and what's inside is brutal.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
I thought I ate chocolate, but it tastes like a pork bowl...
What a cruel betrayal.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...I've suddenly developed an intense craving for sweets.
Alright, you, go make me something right this instant.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Come on, huuuu-rryyyy uuup! Right now,
I fiercely crave some proper sweets!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Gateau chocolat, chiffon cake, anything goes!
Just make some delicious sweets!
Urged on by her, I began cooking...
The chocolate cookies are ready.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, this turned out quite well, didn't it,
my dear guinea pig!
And so, enjoying homemade cookies alongside Agnes Tachyon, we spent a heartwarming Valentine's Day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Valentine's Day isn't so bad after all!
Ahahaha!
